title: Classify post-merge observability drift as non-blocking and preserve trusted readback diagnostics

phases.objective: Keep repository inventory and evaluation evidence authoritative while classifying known post-merge observability staleness as advisory and non-blocking, and preserve fail-closed behavior for unclassified readback failures.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: main or Production receives a push and the inventory/evaluation readback workflows verify exact-head derived artifacts.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Known stale observability produces explicit advisory evidence and a successful non-blocking workflow result; unexpected verification failures remain blocking and fail closed.
steps: Verify exact checked-out head and derived-state policy invariants.
Classify only the declared stale_observability contract as advisory.
Publish bounded evidence and retain post-merge follow-up requirements.
Keep all database, migration, provider, policy Apply, and production activation operations disabled.
assertions: The advisory path requires followup_required=true and followup_mode=post_merge_observability_publish.
The advisory path exits successfully without claiming that the artifact is current.
Non-advisory verification failures still exit non-zero.
No secrets are written to evidence.
No runtime, database, migration, grant, provider, Branch Protection, Ruleset, or Production activation mutation is introduced.
